newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak 4-week T-bill average yield up to 14.21 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovak 4-week T-bill average yield up to 14.21 pct.

text.p: Average yield at an auction of Slovak finance ministry four-week treasury bills on Wednesday rose to 14.21 percent, the National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said in a statement.
Average yield in the last successful auction of four-week T-bills on March 13, was 13.277 percent.
The statement said the ministry accepted bids worth 2.203 billion crowns from a total of 3.393 billion.
No further details were given and ministry officials were not immediately available for comment.
In the last auction of four-week treasury bills on April 30, the finance ministry rejected all of the 1.325 billion crowns worth of bids.

The ministry uses its T-bills and state bonds as main tools to cover the state budget deficit, which totalled 3.45 billion crowns in the first quarter of 1997, up from a shortfall of 361.3 million crowns for the first two monhs of this year.
